SYMPTOM: Maestro dark mode page showed keyboard in light mode — both native and Whisnap keyboards rendered light regardless of dark page background

CAUSE: iOS keyboard appearance follows SYSTEM appearance (UIUserInterfaceStyle), NOT the host app's page background color. The keyboard is rendered by the OS, not the app.

FIX: To test keyboard dark mode, change system appearance:
```bash
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance dark
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance light  # to reset
```

PREVENT: Don't test dark mode via page background color tricks — only the system appearance toggle works
